description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter-based restaurant app. The widget builds the main home screen layout, including app bar, navigation, and various UI components such as story card, hours/contact info, category chips, and navigation bar. It also references several external services, providers, routing, and widgets.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that serves as the main screen for the app, displaying restaurant info, category chips, and navigation options.

classes.name: _StoryCard
classes.description: A small widget displaying the restaurant's story within a Card layout.

classes.name: _HoursAndContact
classes.description: Widget displaying operating hours and contact options, including buttons for calling, WhatsApp, directions, and sharing location.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Navigation bar widget to switch between main sections of the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar, list view, and bottom navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _StoryCard widget, displaying the restaurant story.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _HoursAndContact widget, displaying hours and contact buttons.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _BottomNav widget, rendering navigation bar.
